name: Profit Margin Calculator for WooCommerce
author: InfinityTechCare

sections.description:
Profit Margin Calculator for WooCommerce plugin adds cost price fields to your WooCommerce products and automatically calculates:

  • Profit amount
  • Profit margin (%)
  • Profit and margin for variable products
  • Optional columns in the admin product list

This plugin is designed for store owners who want to easily track profitability without installing heavy accounting plugins.

🔥 Key Features

  • Add cost price to simple & variable products
  • Automatic profit & margin calculation
  • Display profit/margin inside product edit pages
  • Optional profit & margin columns in WooCommerce → Products table
  • Rounding controls (none, 0, 1, 2 decimals)
  • Highly optimized and lightweight
  • Fully compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)
  • Compatible with any theme or WooCommerce setup

💡 Why Use This Plugin?

Most shop owners want to know how much they are actually making per product.
This plugin solves that in the simplest way—no complex reports, no accounting module, just clean, instant profit calculations.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through Plugins → Installed Plugins
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Profit Calculator to configure options
  4. Edit any product and enter the Cost Price to automatically see calculated profit and margin
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with variable products?

Yes. Each variation can have its own cost price, profit, and margin calculations.

Does the plugin support custom rounding?

Yes. You can choose:
– No rounding
– 0 decimals
– 1 decimal
– 2 decimals

Does it affect the frontend?

No. All calculations are for admins only and never shown to customers.

Does it work with HPOS?

Yes. HPOS is fully supported.
